title: QUANTIFYING AUTOMATION RISK IN HIGH-AUTOMATION AI SYSTEMS: A BAYESIAN FRAMEWORK FOR FAILURE PROPAGATION AND OPTIMAL OVERSIGHT
reasoning: The paper provides a mathematical and theoretical framework for quantifying failure propagation and risk in automated AI systems. While it discusses 'harm' and 'AI safety,' which are ethical concerns in a broad sense, it does not evaluate or benchmark religious, moral, or ethical values, focusing instead on structural risk decomposition and resource allocation for oversight.
